title: Settings
helper_avatar: Choose the illustration that represents you on Verbatims.
avatar_picker_helper: Choose from Tronche’s illustrated styles. Your selection will appear across your profile.
avatar_import_format: Paste a Tronche.cc avatar URL or its /api/avatar path.
avatar_import_invalid: Enter an HTTPS avatar URL from tronche.cc, or a /api/avatar path from its playground.
avatar_customizer_helper: Change this avatar’s style and colors. Your edits will appear in the preview.
error_save_avatar: Could not save your avatar. Please try again.
helper_email_verification: It stays active until the new one is verified.
email_change_sent: We sent a confirmation link to your new address. Your current email remains active until you confirm it.
error_email_in_use: That address is already linked to another account. Try a different one.
error_email_same: Enter an address different from your current one.
error_email_change: We couldn't send the confirmation link. Please try again.
helper_language: Choose which quote languages appear by default.
language_info_intro: Verbatims has two language settings with different purposes.
language_info_content_body: This setting affects which quotes are shown by default in your feeds and lists.
language_info_interface_body: This setting controls the language of menus, buttons, labels, and other controls. Change it from the language menu in the top bar.
change_password_prompt: I want to change my password
error_password_length: New password must be at least 8 characters.
desc_public_profile: Allow others to see your profile and public collections.
desc_show_attribution: Display your name as the submitter on approved quotes.
helper_theme: Choose your preferred theme for the application.
home_image_attribution_description: Choose how the homepage image credit is shown when the page loads.
home_image_attribution_auto_help: The credit stays expanded for six seconds after the page loads, then collapses.
desc_quote_approval: Get notified when your submitted quotes are approved or rejected.
desc_collection_updates: Get notified when someone adds quotes to your public collections.
desc_weekly_digest: Receive a weekly summary of new quotes and activity.
desc_delete_account: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
dialog_delete_body: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This will permanently remove:
dialog_delete_item_quotes: All your submitted quotes (drafts, pending, and published)
